method: read-only tools/probe-system.py over ssh; no sudo, no fabric change, no model load. Each host carries its own probe time in evidence/runtime/<obligation>/manifest.json; the top-level captured_at is the end of the capture round.

gpu.H100-SXM.note: Probe describes the H100-SXM SKU; the host carries eight of them.

gpu.B200.note: Probe describes the B200 SKU; the host carries eight of them.

gpu.GB300.note: Record describes the GB300 superchip scope (2 GPUs, 1 CPU); the host reports four GPUs.
